artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture is unnaturally smooth and uniform, lacking the micro-scratches, weld seams, and bolt details expected on heavy steel machinery. It resembles a low-poly 3D model or airbrushed render rather than a photograph.
The circular disc coulters appear slightly elliptical and inconsistent in perspective alignment with the rest of the frame, suggesting minor geometric warping.
The hydraulic rams and connecting pins lack clear mechanical definition; some parts seem to merge into the frame without distinct separation or mounting hardware.
